top_signals.title: Fed’s Hammack Says ‘Some Number’ of Rate Hikes May Be Needed
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said it’s possible a number of interest rate hikes may be needed to bring inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target, but she does not want to prejudge what the end point will be.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Iran Doing Good Job of Rattling Trump, Says Bernard Haykel
top_signals.summary: Professor Bernard Haykel said that President Trump has to be much cooler around negotiations with Iran, as the Iran's government is succeeding at 'rattling' the US president. Haykel, who teaches at Princeton, said that Iran cannot keep sole control of the Strait of Hormuz because that would let them keep the world 'over a barrel.'  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen Weakens 1%, Erases Half of US-Japan Intervention Gains
top_signals.summary: The yen extended its losses, erasing half of the gains triggered when authorities from the US and Japan intervened in the foreign-exchange market to support the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee puts Eric Balchunas, Jon Maier, chief ETF strategist for JPMorgan Asset Management, and Mayuranki De, vice president of ETF trade strategy at Raymond James, to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
